_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see config/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Share of a code search (file_search find) result's score that comes from matching words; the meaning matcher gives the rest.
examples: rank code search more by exact words
trust the meaning matcher more in find
find should care less about identifiers

settings.description: Code blocks one code search (file_search find) shows the agent.
examples: show 10 find results
fewer code search results
let find list more blocks

settings.description: Most candidate blocks one checkout area (such as ui/chat or one crate) passes to the meaning matcher in a code search.
examples: let each folder pass more blocks to find
fewer candidates per area in code search
widen find within one module

settings.description: Most candidate blocks a whole code search passes to the meaning matcher; more finds more but each one costs matcher time.
examples: make code search faster
let find consider 600 blocks
fewer candidates so find stops timing out

settings.description: Files and folders one area's code search scan may visit before it reports a limited scan.
examples: let find scan more files
stop code search scans being cut short
smaller find scans

settings.description: Seconds one area's code search scan may take before it reports a limited scan.
examples: give find scans more time
code search scans time out too soon
shorter find scan time

settings.description: Days the code search (find) hit and miss log keeps each lookup.
examples: keep the find log for a year
forget old code search logs sooner
how long find results are tracked
